Name: Robin Sells Machines (1.6 Compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]I know many people have made individual mods for each machine, but I wanted something that had them [i]all[/i]. And, most importantly, I wanted something that was compatible with Version 1.6. Et Voila, Robin Sells Machines!

This mod adds the following to the top of Robin's sale menu:[/size]

[list]
[*]Clay - 10
[*]Fiber - 10
[*]Hardwood - 60
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]And the following to the bottom of Robin's sale menu:[/size]
[u]Chests:[/u][list]
[*]Chests - 500
[*]Stone Chests - 1000
[*]Big Chests - 1600
[*]Big Stone Chests - 5000
[*]Junimo Chests - 6000
[/list][u]
Fences[/u]

[*]Wood Fences - 20
[*]Stone Fences - 40
[*]Hardwood Fences - 60
[*]Gate - 100
[/list]
[u]Signs[/u]

[*]Wood Sign - 250
[*]Stone Sign - 500
[/list]

[/list]All prices are easily configurable using GMCM, and all machines are buyable starting in year 1! Machines can also be enabled or disabled using GMCM

[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
No known issues with any other mods. If you have a mod that completely overrides the Carpenter shop list then I could see those conflicting.

[size=4][b]To Install:[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]! Just drag this bad boy into your mods folder and you should be good to go! If you want to change the prices, you can edit the config.json or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to edit it right in your game!

[size=4][b]To Uninstall:[/b][/size]
Delete it! Shouldn't cause any issues in current playthroughs, it only touches the Carpenter shop.

[size=4][b]Recommended Mods[/b][/size]:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20985]Self-Serve[/url] to access the shop even when she isn't there
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20648]Friendships Affect Prices[/url] for obvious reasons
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27102]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url] for machines that felt they fit Clint's shop more
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27249]Willy Sells Fish Machines[/url] for machines that felt they fit Willy's shop more

Downloads.Description: Fixed an issue with the manifest to show the proper version number in SMAPI. Functionally, nothing has changed but most people like a clean SMAPI log so here!
